auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Datagma API key sent as the apiId query parameter. Get or view it in the Datagma API dashboard: https://app.datagma.com/user-api

actions.name: detect_job_change
actions.description: Check whether a contact still works at their last-known company or appears to have changed jobs.

firstName.description: The contact's first name when fullName is not supplied.

lastName.description: The contact's last name when fullName is not supplied.

jobTitle.description: The contact's last-known job title, used to disambiguate people with similar names.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for checking whether a contact changed jobs with Datagma.

result.description: The raw JSON result returned by Datagma; available enrichment fields vary by lookup type and enabled options.

actions.name: enrich_person_or_company
actions.description: Enrich a person or company from an email, LinkedIn URL, domain, company identifier, or name-and-company combination.

data.description: A professional email address, LinkedIn profile URL, company domain, company name, or French SIREN number.

firstName.description: The person's first name; use it with lastName and company when data is not provided.

lastName.description: The person's last name; use it with firstName and company when data is not provided.

fullName.description: The person's full name; use it with company when data is not provided.

company.description: The person's company name or domain when enriching by name instead of the data field.

companyKeyword.description: A disambiguating keyword such as an industry, founder, or location for company-name enrichment.

countryCode.description: A country code that narrows the Datagma search and reduces namesake matches.

companyPremium.description: Whether to include LinkedIn-derived company details such as employees, industry, and locations.

companyFull.description: Whether to include extended company financial, funding, technology, and traffic details.

companyFrench.description: Whether to include French SIREN directory information for the matched company.

personFull.description: Whether to include the person's extended profile, education, experience, skills, and posts.

phoneFull.description: Whether to search for a mobile phone number when enriching from a name and company.

deepTraffic.description: Whether to include detailed website traffic sources, countries, and similar-site data.

debug.description: Whether to include lower-confidence matches and additional scoring details.

whatsappCheck.description: Whether Datagma should check if returned phone numbers are associated with WhatsApp.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for enriching a person or company with Datagma.

result.description: The raw JSON result returned by Datagma; available enrichment fields vary by lookup type and enabled options.

actions.name: find_work_email
actions.description: Find and verify a person's work email from their name plus a company domain, company name, or LinkedIn company URL.

firstName.description: The person's first name when fullName is not supplied.

lastName.description: The person's last name when fullName is not supplied.

company.description: The company domain or company name.

linkedInSlug.description: The LinkedIn company URL used to resolve the employer when a company domain is unavailable.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for finding a verified work email with Datagma.

result.description: The raw JSON result returned by Datagma; available enrichment fields vary by lookup type and enabled options.

actions.name: get_credit
actions.description: Get the remaining API credit balance for the connected Datagma account.

email.description: The account email to include when Datagma requires it for credit lookup.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for reading the connected Datagma account's credit balance.

result.description: The raw JSON result returned by Datagma; available enrichment fields vary by lookup type and enabled options.

actions.name: search_phone_numbers
actions.description: Find mobile phone numbers from an email address, a social-profile URL, or both, with optional confidence and WhatsApp checks.

email.description: The person's email address used to search for mobile phone numbers.

username.description: The person's LinkedIn or other supported social-profile URL used for phone lookup.

minimumMatch.description: The minimum match threshold passed to Datagma.

whatsappCheck.description: Whether Datagma should check if returned phone numbers are associated with WhatsApp.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for finding mobile phone numbers with Datagma.

result.description: The raw JSON result returned by Datagma; available enrichment fields vary by lookup type and enabled options.
